issues.description: The problem statement (line 16) instructs that the output string buffer must be pre-initialized with 0xFF before copying text, but neither the template nor the solution provide such a buffer or any code to perform this initialization. This discrepancy may confuse students about whether they must add a buffer and initialization code (and where/how to do it) for this trivial Hello World task.
issues.suggested_fix: Either remove the (irrelevant) instruction about pre-filling an output buffer from the problem statement or update the template (and solution) to include an explicit buffer and initialization code. For example, add a reserved buffer in .bss and show code that fills it with 0xFF before copying the string, or clarify in the statement that this step is not required for this Hello World exercise.
